'''Griffon Flight Wing''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].

==History==
The squadron saw action during the [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. During the battle, they engaged the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']].

Notable [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] included [[Elyhek Rue/Legends|Elyhek Rue]] and [[Wenton Chan/Legends|Wenton Chan]], who later went on to fly with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]],<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> both [[Death/Legends|dying]] over the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
